question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Enthuse
solution:
The correct answer is "Fondle."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Enthuse" **means express eager enjoyment, interest, or approval regarding something. (किसी चीज़ के संबंध में उत्सुक आनंद, रुचि या अनुमोदन व्यक्त करना)

 
 
• **Example**: *He was **enthusing**__ over a wonderful restaurant he'd been to.*
 
 
 
• The synonym of** "Enthuse"** is **"Fondle."**
 
• The word **"Fondle"** means stroke or caress lovingly or erotically. (प्यार से या कामुक ढंग से सहलाना)
 __
 
• **Example**:* She **fondled**__ the puppies.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Carefree: **with no problems or worries. (निश्चिंत, बेफ़िक्र, चिंतामुक्त)
 
• **Unbothered: **not worried or concerned. (चिंतित नहीं)
 
• **Lazy: **(used about a person) not wanting to work. ((व्‍यक्ति) जो काम न करना चाहे; आलसी, कामचोर)
